据称出自“南洋兄弟烟草厂工人要求平等待遇及增加工资临时代表组”并题为《致南洋兄弟烟草厂全体工友书》的小册子译文摘要。
----

1931年，管理层引入了工作“包工制”，因此获得了巨额利润。1932年底，他们将部分利润作为“效率奖金”分配给工人，但大部分款项被李辉（Li Hui）侵吞。该罪行被……察觉，随即解雇了相关责任人员……

职员雇员并未……他们获得了普遍加薪，幅度为10%至50%。然而，工人未获任何加薪。在……上增加……我们也要求……审计账目……在未来。

November Date 22 / 11 / 33.

Labour (3)

Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory - ex-workers
attempt to create unrest

Copies of a handbill chopped "Provisional Representative
Group of Employees and Workers of the Nanyang Brothers
Tobacco Factory to Demand a Flat Increase" were found
distributed on the factory premises on November 21. This
handbill declares that all workers should benefit by an
increase in wages as the business of the Company has
prospered during the year. It is learned that the
reasonable
persons for this agitation are two ex-workers named
Joo Joong (吴松) and Chang Tsang (章强) who were
supporters of Li Hwei (李辉), ex-Chief Supervisor,
during the trouble in the factory in March, 1933.

Tien Tsang Paper Mills - Strike

The strike declared by the 160 workers of the Tien
Tsang Paper Mill, North Hu Tang Road, Pootung continues
this morning, November 22.

At 7 a.m. November 21, one hundred and sixteen
employees of the head Factory of the same concern at
No.403 Yangtszepoo Road, declared a strike in support of
their colleagues in Pootung and are still out.

These workers are protesting against the agreement
made on November 16 between the management and officials
of the Workers' Unions on the plea that it was signed
without the knowledge of the workers themselves. They
also complain that their wages are six weeks in arrears.

天章造纸厂——罢工

位于浦东胡唐路（North Hu Tang Road）的天章造纸厂160名工人宣布的罢工持续至今日（11月22日）上午。

11月21日上午7时，同一企业在杨树浦路403号的总厂的一百一十六名雇员为支持其在浦东的同事而宣布罢工，目前仍处于停工状态。

Subject (in full) Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company - Final Settlement
of Dispute - Further Report in re.
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by A.T. Justice

Following the dismissal of Li Hwei (李惠)
from the services of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Co.
and the resignation of Kan Ying Foo (簡英甫) from the
position of assistant manager, the pair invested their ill gotten
gains in the Dah Yung Rubber Factory, No.1 Chining Road,
which is reported to be in financial difficulties.
In the meantime the workers of the Nanyang
Brothers Tobacco Co. who had been deprived of their
"Efficiency Bonus", instituted proceedings against Li
Hwei in the 1st Special District Court for the
restitution of the funds. Li Hwei remained in hiding
for many months and eventually persuaded Kan Ying Foo
to effect a compromise with the workers. Lam put
the matter before the proprietor of the Kung Duh Ling
(功德林), a vegetarian restaurant on Park Road, one
Zau Yoong Chi who promised to assist. The workers
were approached and consented to accept $6,000.00 in
settlement of their claim.
They proceeded to the management of the Nanyang
Brothers Tobacco Co. divulging their intention to accept
the settlement. Kam Yuen Keh (甘元恪), General Manager
informed them that if they accepted the $6,000.00, the
claim before the Shanghai Special District Court would
automatically become void. He further stated that
whatever settlement was made would be between the workers
and Li Hwei, and that the management would not consider
themselves liable for the payment of the sum outstanding.
The workers declared that they fully appreciated the
situation and requested the management to take the $6,000,

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I., Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 4611
Date October 12, 1933.

Subject (in full) Nanyang Dispute - Members of the Special Branch
actively employed in its investigation.

Made by D. S. I. Golder Forwarded by [Signature] C.S.I.

For the past few years there has been continual
bickering among the management of the Nanyang Brothers
Tobacco Company whose factory is situated on Broadway.
The two main contestants were Kan Yueh-kah, General Manager
and Kan Ying-foo, his brother who was Assistant-Manager.
Late in 1932 Kan Yueh-kah found it necessary owing to
indifferent health to proceed to his native Canton where
he stayed some three months. During his absence Kan Ying-
foo, the younger brother, was left virtually in supreme
command of the Company. He, by reason of his dissolute
behaviour, became concerned in the misappropriation of the
workers' "Efficiency" Bonus about $80,000.00, the prime
mover in the conspiracy being one Li Hwei, a disreputable
person and follower of Doo Yoeh-sung, who needs no
introduction. Upon the return of Kan Yoeh-kah from
Canton in the early part of the year, the whole plot was
divulged to him but by that time Doo Yoeh-sung had gained
a strong hold over Kan Ying-foo through the duplicity of
Li Hwei, and was literally dictating the policy of the
management towards its employees, for which type of graft
Doo Yoeh Sung is famous. Eventually the position between
Doo Yoeh Sung and the management, by reason of the untiring
efforts of the Chinese Staff of this office, became clarified.
The French Town clique were demanding something in the
region of $400,000.00 for the settlement of a dispute
between the factions and it was in this connection that
the Special Branch were employed. The enquiry from
start to finish was of a more or less confidential nature
and called for a great deal of tact and discretion.

主题（全称） 南洋纠纷——特别股成员积极参与调查。

由 D. S. I. Golder 制作 转呈 [签名] C.S.I.

过去几年间，位于百老汇路的南洋兄弟烟草公司管理层内部一直争吵不断。两个主要的竞争者是总经理简岳卡（Kan Yueh-kah，音译）和他的弟弟、副经理简英甫（Kan Ying-foo）。1932年末，简岳卡因健康状况不佳，不得不前往其家乡广东，在那里停留了约三个月。在他缺席期间，弟弟简英甫实际上掌握了公司的最高指挥权。他因行为放荡，卷入了侵吞工人“效率”奖金约80,000.00美元的案件，阴谋的主要策划者是一个名叫李辉（Li Hwei）的不名誉人物，他是杜月笙（Doo Yoeh-sung）的追随者，杜月笙之名无需赘述。年初简岳卡从广东回来后，整个阴谋向他揭露，但此时通过李辉的欺诈手段，杜月笙已牢牢控制了简英甫，并实际上在 dictate（支配）管理层对其雇员的政策，这种类型的贪污是杜月笙所闻名的。最终，由于本办事处华籍职员的不懈努力，杜月笙与管理层之间的局势变得明朗化。法租界帮派要求约400,000.00美元以解决派系间的纠纷，特别股正是为此事而被启用。从头到尾的调查都具有某种保密性质，需要大量的策略和谨慎。

Subject (in full) Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company -
Dispute settled.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by J. Bruce C.S.I.

The dispute between two factions of the Management
of the above concern and their workers, which arose over
the alleged misappropriation of $80,000 representing
workers' "Efficiency Bonus", has been finally settled. The
Management have paid $5.00 each to 902 workers and a total
of $1,100.00 to the foremen. Li Hwei (李辉), the person
allegedly responsible for the disappearance of the money,
contributed $4,000.00 whilst the remainder was contributed
by the Company.

It will be remembered that the aggrieved parties
instituted proceedings against Li Hwei in the 1st Special
District Court for the recovery of the "Efficiency Bonus"
but failed to obtain satisfaction owing to the continued
absence of the defendant. It is now reported that the
suit has been withdrawn since Li Hwei has made part
restitution.

E. Golder
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上述公司管理层两派及其工人之间因据称挪用代表工人“效率奖金”的80,000美元而引发的纠纷，现已最终解决。管理层已向902名工人每人支付5.00美元，并向工头支付总计1,100.00美元。据称对资金失踪负有责任的李辉（Li Hwei）出资4,000.00美元，其余部分由公司出资。

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

With the resignation of Kam Ying Foo from the
position of assistant Manager of the Company.work among
the managerial staff of Nanyang Brothers has become
practically normal. The quietness of the present situation,
it would appear, has been reflected upon the general
operatives who are more or less contented. As in the past
a careful watch will be kept for any agitation.

The assassination of Dong Kar Bang, and the
resulting temporary dispersal of his followers have robbed
Chang Zang-nyi alias Siau Chang of what power he held
heretofore.

Information has been obtained that Chang is at
present living a very quiet life, whilst his name has not
been mentioned in connection with the Nanyang Brothers
dispute for the past many weeks.

Kan Ying-foo (簡英甫), Vice Manager of the
Nanyang Bros. Tobacco Co. tendered his resignation to
the Board of Directors of the Company on July 10 and it
is reported that his resignation has been accepted.
It is confidentially understood that Kam Yoch-
kei, General Manager of the Company and a few other
directors who are on intimate terms with Kan Ying-foo
have promised to make good the sum of $80,000 which has
been misappropriated by Kan Ying-foo during his term of
office.
It will be recalled that Li Hwei (李輝),
the ex-factory Superintendent of the Factory, whose
dismissal in November, 1932 by the General Manager
following the discovery of his embezzlement of workers
bonus was one of the direct causes of the trouble in
the factory, was Kan Ying-foo's protégé, and consequently,
it is expected that the resignation of Kan Ying-foo will
further clear the atmosphere in connection with the
trouble.

of the management - attempted extortion by certain loafers in the French
Concession.
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Hw Robertson, Supt.

Careful enquiries have been carried out in the above
connection over the past few weeks, but have failed to
produce any useful information.

Over the Nanyang case and other matters the ranks
of the French Concession gangs have been divided against
themselves with the result that two of their most prominent
members have been assassinated. The first murder occurred
on April 23 at Swatow and Yunnan Roads corner when Dzung 陳
榮
Yoong Sung, a native of Canton, aged 48, was shot to death.
This crime, it was generally believed, was committed at
the instigation of Dong Kar Bang (唐嘉鵬) alias Dong Ah
Yue (唐阿裕) who fearing that Dzung Yoong Sung was waxing
too powerful had him removed. In retaliation for the
death of Dzung Yoong Sung, Dong Kar Bang was shot and
killed by armed men outside the Great World on Avenue Edward VII
at 1 a.m. on June 8, 1933. Very little information has
come to hand in this office concerning the latter crime
but it is believed that Wong Ching Yoong (黃金榮), leader
of the gang of which Dong Kar Bang was a member, knows
a great deal about it.

The death of Dong Kar Bang may considerably
clear the atmosphere in connection with the Nanyang trouble,
he being one of the prime movers in the attempted extortion

过去几周就上述事项进行了仔细调查，但未能产生任何有用信息。

围绕南洋案及其他事件，法租界帮派内部发生分裂，导致其两名最显赫的成员被暗杀。第一起谋杀案发生在4月23日，地点为汕头路与云南路转角，48岁的广东籍男子陈荣松（Dzung Yoong Sung，音译）被枪杀。普遍认为，这起犯罪是在董嘉邦（Dong Kar Bang，音译），又名董阿裕（Dong Ah Yue，音译）的唆使下实施的，董因担心陈荣松势力过大而将其除掉。作为对陈荣松之死的报复，董嘉邦于1933年6月8日凌晨1点在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）大世界外被武装人员枪杀。本办公室关于后一起案件的情报很少，但据信，作为董嘉邦所属帮派头目的黄金荣（Wong Ching Yoong）对此知情甚多。

董嘉邦之死可能会大大澄清与南洋纠纷有关的局面，因为他是企图勒索的主要策划者之一

Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory - Unrest
It is reported that as a means to overcome the
decision of the management to transfer them to the
factories of the concern at Hongkong or Hankow, the
five committee members of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco
Factory Office of the 4th District Tobacco Factory
Workers' Union who are the ringleaders of the present
unrest in the factory, are endeavouring to induce the
other workers to declare a strike.
In this connection these persons have held several
meetings during the last few days in various sing song
houses in the French Concession.

Nyi Woo Rubber Factory - workers appeal to the
Bureau of Social Affairs
At 9.30 p.m. June 8, some 30 female workers of
the Nyi Woo Rubber Factory, Shanghai-Ninghong Road,
Nantao, accompanied by a delegate of the 1st District
Rubber Factory Workers' Union, appealed to the Bureau
of Social Affairs for assistance in urging the management
to accept the following demands :-
1. That the system of restricting the output be abolished.
(Due to trade depression, each worker is allowed to
make only half a dozen shoes a day).
2. That no fines be imposed upon workers for wasting
material.
3. That a date be fixed for the issue of wages each month.
4. That fines already collected from workers be returned
to them.
The organ promised to deal with the dispute.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE DAH YOONG VULCANIZING WORKS.

The Dah Yoong Vulcanizing Works on Thorburn Road suspended work on May 27. About 500 hands are affected. Representatives of the 4th District Vulcanizing Trade Workers Union negotiated but without result.
At 10 a.m. yesterday, the workers gathered at the gate of the Works and demanded that food supplies be issued to them until work is resumed.
At the request of the 4th District Vulcanizing Trade Workers Union, representatives of the local Tangpu and the General Labour Union called at the Works and requested the management to issue a food allowance so that untoward incidents might be averted.
As the General Manager is at Nanking on business, there was no responsible person in the Works who could give a reply to the demand.
The workers were advised by the delegates of the local Tangpu and General Labour Union to await a settlement of the dispute according to law.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE NANYANG BROTHERS TOBACCO CO.

As the General Manager of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company regards the Workers Union as an illegal body, a petition to place restrictions on the Union has been submitted to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and the Social Bureau.
On June 1, the Municipality instructed the Social Bureau to notify the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory Workers Union to reorganise itself.
At 10 a.m. yesterday, representatives of the 4th District Tobacco Trade Workers Union submitted a petition to the Social Bureau requesting arbitration and investigation of the dispute at an early date.
Wu Shih-yuan, a representative of the Union, stated that , apart from refuting the allegations contained in the petition of the management, the workers are accusing the Company of having violated Articles 31, 32, 33, 48 and 49 of the Labour Union Law and should be punished.
The Union will make an appeal to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai on June 9.

No reliable information in connection with
the above matter has been received for the past two
weeks. There is every indication that Doo Yoeh Sung
and his henchmen have temporarily abandoned the hope
of obtaining any further payment from the management
as represented by Kam Yueh-kah. Agitation among the

主题（全称）南洋兄弟烟草厂 - 管理层派系之间的纠纷。
由特别调查员 Golder 撰写，经警司 Tho Robertson 转发。

过去两周未收到有关上述事项的可靠情报。种种迹象表明，杜月笙（Doo Yoeh Sung）及其亲信已暂时放弃从以金月嘉（Kam Yueh-kah，音译）为代表的管理层那里获得进一步付款的希望。工厂工人中的煽动活动仍在继续，但没有任何迹象表明法租界帮派参与其中。
前工厂主管李揮（Li Hwei），因追讨17万美元而在上海特区地方法院对其提起民事诉讼，现已潜逃，针对他的案件因此悬而未决。
据报道，张尚义（Chang Zang Nee）（小张，Siau Chang）正与亲属安静地生活，据所知，他已被杜月笙（Doo Yueh Sung）和唐定鵬（Tang Kar Bang）抛弃。

Labour

Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory - Municipality of
Greater Shanghai orders closing of the Nanyang
Factory Workers' Branch Office of the 4th District
Tobacco Factory Workers' Union

Between 7 and 8 p.m. June 3, five Chinese claiming
to represent the workers of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco
Factory held a meeting in the 4th District Tobacco Factory
Workers' Union, 8 San Loh Li, Haikal Road. Woo Dz-yu
(吳士元) who presided, stated that as a result of
arrangement by the Company, a notice has been received
from the Municipality charging the organization of the
Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory Workers' Branch Office
as being illegal and therefore instructing it to cease
functioning. It was finally decided that three of the
attendance be entrusted with the task of making arrange-
ments for an appeal to the Chinese Authorities to secure
permission for the establishment of the organization.

It is learned thar four Cantonese committee members
of the Office have tendered their resignation due to
dissension with the above Chinese who are also committee
members of the body.

6月3日晚7时至8时之间，五名自称代表南洋兄弟烟草厂工人的中国人在海格路（Haikal Road）三乐里8号第四区烟草厂工人联合会举行会议。主持会议的吴士元（Woo Dz-yu）表示，由于公司的安排，已收到市政府的通知，指控南洋兄弟烟草厂工人联合分支办事处的组织为非法，因此指令其停止运作。最后决定，委托三名与会者负责安排向中国政府上诉，以求得建立该组织的许可。

据悉，该办事处的四名广东籍委员因与同为该机构委员的上述中国人发生分歧，已提出辞职。

May 20, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE NANYANG BROTHERS TOBACCO CO.

With reference to the dispute between the
Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company and its workers, a
small number of workers is disseminating handbills
in the 4th District Rolled Tobacco Trade Workers
Union with the object of instigating the whole body of
workers to withdraw from the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco
Company Workers Union.

Demands Submitted.

At 11.30 a.m. yesterday, four representatives
of the 4th District Rolled Tobacco Trade Workers Union
submitted the following demands to the Social Bureau:-
1. That workers refrain from holding meetings
and that the source of handbills be ascertained.
2. That a mediation meeting to discuss the
dismissal of 15 men be called immediately.
3. That the newly drafted 24 articles be enforced
as soon as possible.
The representatives were received by an
official of the Third Department of the Bureau and were
informed that a mediation meeting will be held at
9 a.m. May 22.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE DAH CHUNG VULCANIZING WORKS.

At a general meeting held at 1 p.m. yesterday
by the entire body of workers of the Dah Chung
Vulcanizing Works at the General Labour Union, Foh Yeu
Road, Nantao, representatives of the local Tangpu, the
General Labour Union and 100 representatives of
workers of various vulcanizing works were present.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1. That the following measures be adopted for
the relief of workers:-
a) To issue a manifesto.
b) To solicit relief funds from various labour unions.
c) To submit a petition to the local Tangpu and then
to request the Shanghai Municipality General Labour
Union to notify various labour unions to issue
relief funds.
2. That a petition be submitted to the local Tangpu
and other political organs requesting them to instruct
the Works to resume operations immediately.
3. That an "Oppressed Workers Appeal Committee Of
the Dah Chung Vulcanizing Works" be formed with eleven
members.

提交的要求。

昨日上午11时30分，第四区卷烟业工会的四名代表向社会局提交了以下要求：-
1. 禁止工人举行集会，并查明传单的来源。

3. 尽快执行新起草的24条条款。
代表们受到了该局第三科官员的接见，并被告知将于5月22日上午9时举行调解会议。

大中华硫化厂工人。

昨日午后1时，大中华硫化厂全体工人在南市福佑路总工会举行大会，当地党部、总工会代表以及各硫化厂工人代表100人出席。
通过了以下决议：-
1. 采取以下措施救济工人：-
a) 发表宣言。
b) 向各工会募集救济金。
c) 向当地党部提交请愿书，然后请求上海市总工会通知各工会发放救济金。

Labour. (2)

Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory

At 10.30 a.m. May 19 four persons claiming to
represent the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory Office
of the 4th District Tobacco Factory Workers' Union called
at the Bureau of Social Affairs and submitted a petition
containing the following demands :-

1. That the Factory be instructed to refrain from urging
part of the workers to oppose the aforementioned Office.

2. That in connection with the handbills opposing the
Workers' Office recently found in the Factory, efforts
be made to detect the persons responsible for the
dissemination of the literature.

3. That the 15 workers who were recently dismissed by
the management be reinstated.

4. That the dispute in connection with the 24 demands
submitted by the workers to the management be
settled as soon as possible.

Wong Ping, a staff member of the Bureau, who
received them replied that their request as mentioned
in the foregoing demands Nos.1 & 2 would be complied
with and meeting of representatives of the parties
concerned would be convened to discuss the latter two
demands.

A notice purporting to emanate from the Workers'
Office was posted on May 19 in the Factory. This notice
apart from accusing the Factory of instigating a minority
of workers to oppose the Office in question, urged the
workers not to participate in the meeting (date not
mentioned) alleged to have been convened by the management
of the Factory.

5月19日上午10时30分，四名自称代表第四区烟草厂工人联合会南洋兄弟烟草厂办事处的人士前往社会局，提交了一份包含以下要求的请愿书：-

1. 指令工厂不得煽动部分工人反对上述办事处。

LABOUR

China Times and other local newspapers.

THE WORKERS OF THE NANYANG BROTHERS TOBACCO CO.

Some days ago, the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco
Company Workers Union detailed representatives to submit
the draft of 24 demands examined and revised by the
local Tangpu and to open direct negotiations with the
Company.

Yesterday, the Company sent its reply alleging
that such action on the part of the workers constituted
a violation of Chinese Law. The Company indicated its
intention to reject the demands.

Upon receiving this reply, the Nanyang
Brothers Tobacco Company Workers Union sent a letter to
the Company refuting the allegations.

8. Packing Department ⅖ cent increase for 1,000 cigarettes.

1 cent increase for 100 large packets.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE NANYANG BROTHERS TOBACCO CO.

The local Tangpu has completed the
revision of the 24 demands submitted by the workers
of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company and has sent
them back to the Union which will submit them to the
Company.
Upon receiving these instructions,
representatives of the 4th District Rolled Tobacco
Trade Workers Union and the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco

MISCELLANEOUS

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

THE INSPECTION OF SALTED MEAT.

At the instance of the local Salted Meat and
Ham Merchants Associations, the Chamber of Commerce
yesterday sent a petition to the Executive Yuan, the
Ministry of Industry and the Central Kuomintang
Headquarters demanding that the inspection of meat by
the Public Health Bureau of the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai be cancelled. The petition added that if the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai be allowed to inspect
meat, such inspection would be extended throughout the
whole country.

Subject (in full) Report on a set of 24 demands submitted on May 6 by the Nanyang Tobacco Factory Workers Branch Office of the 4th District Cigarette Factory Workers' Union to the management of the Company for signature
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt.

The attached agreement in the form of 24 demands
was submitted to the management of the above concern on
May 6, 1933 by eight representatives of the Nanyang Brothers
Tobacco Factory Workers Branch Office of the 4th District
Cigarette Factory Workers' Union. The management have
intimated through Mr. Feng Ping-nan that the whole thing
is quite out of proportion and that they will not agree
to it. The following is a translation :
(A) Organization :
Art. 1. That the Shanghai Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company
recognize the 4th District Cigarette Factory
Workers' Union as representative of the
members of the Nanyang Tobacco Factory Workers
Branch Office, and acknowledge the Branch Office
as the representative of the whole body of
employees.
Art. 2. That all employees of the Company and the Factory
be allowed to join the Nanyang Tobacco Factory
Workers' Branch Office of the 4th District Cigarette
Factory Workers' Union. (But that those who represent
the management and/or excercise control be excepted).
Art. 3. That the Company subsidize the Branch Office in the
sum of $500.00 per mensem, and that all fines
imposed on workers be handed over to the Branch
for the benefit of all the workers.
Art. 4. That the Company grant/subsidy to the Branch Office
to establish a school for the children of workers
of the Factory, as well as funds to cover its
operation.

上述企业的管理层于1933年5月6日收到了来自第四区卷烟厂工人联合会南洋兄弟烟草厂工人支部办事处的八名代表提交的一份包含24项要求的协议附件。管理层通过冯平南（Feng Ping-nan，音译）先生示意，此事完全不成比例，他们不会同意。以下是译文：
(A) 组织：
第1条. 上海南洋兄弟烟草公司承认第四区卷烟厂工人联合会为南洋烟草厂工人支部办事处成员的代表，并承认该支部办事处为全体员工的代表。
第2条. 允许公司及工厂的所有员工加入第四区卷烟厂工人联合会南洋烟草厂工人支部办事处。（但代表管理层和/或行使控制权者除外）。
第3条. 公司每月补贴支部办事处500.00元，并且对所有工人处以的罚款应移交给支部，以惠及所有工人。
第4条. 公司拨款/补贴支部办事处，以为工厂工人的子女建立学校，并提供资金以维持其运作。

May 25, 1933. Morning Translation

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE NANYANG BROTHERS TOBACCO COMPANY.

With reference to the dispute between the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company and its workers, the Social Bureau held a mediation meeting at 2 p.m. yesterday at which representatives of the local Tangpu, the Public Safety Bureau, the management and the workers were present.

The representatives of the workers stated that the Company has purposely bringing false accusations against the workers and had dismissed several men without just cause. They demanded reinstatement.

The representatives of the management replied that the men had been dismissed for having violated the rules of the Company and that it was impossible to accept the demand for reinstatement.

Owing to the firm attitude adopted by both sides, the mediation had no result.

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

南洋兄弟烟草公司工人。

关于南洋兄弟烟草公司与其工人之间的纠纷，社会局于昨日下午2时举行调解会议，当地塘浦代表、公安局代表、资方代表及工人代表出席。

工人代表称，公司故意对工人提出虚假指控，并无故解雇了几名工人。他们要求复职。

资方代表回答说，这些人因违反公司规定而被解雇，无法接受复职要求。

由于双方态度坚决，调解未果。

The following is a report submitted to the
undersigned by an agent of Woo Linquan, lawyer, of
No.43 Peking Road.

Chang Zang Nyi (張尚義 ) (Siau Chang) is
residing with relatives at 85 Ziang Kong Li, Myburgh
Road, and No.75 Taku Road. It has been learned that
Chang is an opium addict and spends a great deal of
his time in the company of Chinese dancing girls at
hotels and cabarets. During the past few weeks he has
been visiting No.116 Rue Amiral Bayle, the home of
"Wu", a former prominent opium hong owner, where he
plays mahjong, etc.

His connection with Huang Ching Yoong appears
to have been severed temporarily due to his failure to ne-
gotiate the settlement of the Nanyang dispute and other
matters.

From Chang's relatives it has been learned that
he is in the hope of being appointed Chief of the Inspection
Corps of the "Kiangsu Bureau of Narcotics" probably through
the good offices of his friend (Wu) (吳)

The friendship between Tang Kau Sang (唐豪勝) and Chang
is at present very strained owing to Chang's inconsistency
in money matters.

Tang Kau Sang is at present residing at No.50
Luzon Road and No.147 Tang Pu Jao, French Concession.
In addition he has the following rooms at hotels:-

Grand Hotel, Room 511. Great China, Room 416.
Oriental, Room 334. Great Eastern, Room 203,

Confidential Enquiry.
----------------------

The conflict between the workers and the management of
the Nanyang Brothers' Tobacco Co., has been caused by a discord
existing between the director general and the assistant director
of the Company, who are nevertheless two brothers.

Mr. KIEN YU Ka ( the eldest brother and the general director)
is very influential with the Company and has on his side all the
principal employees and in particular one named FONG CHIA LOh.

The younger brother, KIEN YU FU, who is the assistant
director is a follower of Wang King Yong. His partisan was
Li Hoei, the Chief Engineer, who succeeded in grouping around
him all the foremen.

On March 13, 1933, the director general dismissed Li Hoei,
the Chief Engineer, who then advised the workers to establish
a special workers' office for the Nanyang Brothers' Tobacco Co
labourers amidst the workers' syndicate of the 4th district
cigarette factories, to oppose the Director-General. He then
excited his partisans by telling them that the Director General
was giving compensation to his own partisans by granting them
unjustifiable annual increases, whereas, for trifling reasons
he imposed fines on the partisans of the assistant
director. These
activities resulted on March 20 in a fight at one of the
workshops, in consequence of which 15 workers were dismissed.

In order to have better success in his activities, Li Hoei,

Confidential Enquiry.

The conflict between the workers and the management of
the Nanyang Brothers' Tobacco Co., has been caused by a discord
existing between the director general and the assistant director

Mr. KIEN YU Ka ( the eldest brother and the general director)

The younger brother, KIEN YU FU, who is the assistant

him all the foremen.

On March 13, 1933, the director general dismissed Li Hoei,
the Chief Engineer, who then advised the workers to establish
a special workers' office for the Nanyang Brothers' Tobacco Co
labourers amidst the workers' syndicate of the 4th district
cigarette factories, to oppose the Director-General. He then
excited his partisans by telling them that the Director General
was giving compensation to his own partisans by granting them
unjustifiable annual increases, whereas, for trifling reasons
he imposed fines on the partisans of the assistant director. These
activities resulted on March 20 in a fight at one of the
workshops, in consequence of which 15 workers were dismissed.

In order to have better success in his activities, Li Hoei,
the Chief Engineer, got in touch with Zi Foh Seng, a friend

warning him, dismissed this man from the Great World. At the

秘密调查

南洋兄弟烟草公司工人与管理层之间的冲突，是由公司总经理与副经理之间的不和引发的，尽管此二人乃是亲兄弟。

简玉阶先生（兄长兼总经理）在公司内极具影响力，拥有主要职员的支持，特别是名为冯家洛（音译）者。

弟弟简玉甫（音译），即副经理，是王敬荣的门徒。他的支持者包括总工程师李辉（音译），后者成功地将所有工头聚集在自己周围。

1933年3月13日，总经理撤销了总工程师李辉的职务。李辉随即建议工人们组织一个南洋兄弟烟草公司特别工人局，隶属于第四区卷烟厂工人工会内部，以对抗总经理。随后，他煽动其支持者，声称总经理每年都给自己的支持者发放毫无理由的加薪，同时，却因琐碎的理由，

pages.en:
SECRET

il infligeait des retenues de solde aux partisans du di-
recteur adjoint. Ces manoeuvres aboutirent le 20 Mars à une
bagarre dans un des ateliers, à la suite de laquelle, 15
ouvriers furent révoqués.

Pour faire aboutir plus facilement ses manoeuvres, l'
ingénieur en chef LI HOEI s'était mis en rapport avec son
ami ZI FOH SENG, employé au Grand Monde (et disciple de
WANG KING YONG) qui fit tout son possible pour l'aider.

Le directeur général s'est plaint à WANG KING YONG qui,
très mécontent de ce que ZI FOH SENG ait agi sans le préve-
nir, le renvoya du Grand Monde, WANG KING YONG ordonna en
même temps à MAO YU FONG, un autre de ses disciples qui est
membre du comité permanent du syndicat des distributeurs de
journaux, d'aider le Directeur Général à arranger l'affaire
du 20 Mars avec les partisans du Directeur Adjoint.

C'est au cours des pourparlers qui ont eu lieu plus ou
moins confidentiellement dans les hôtels "Ta-Tung", "Tong-
Ya", etc... que FENG CHIA LOH a rencontré MAO YU FONG.

Jusqu'ici, l'intervention de ce dernier ne paraît pas
avoir aggravé les choses. Une certaine agitation a continué
à régner parmi les ouvriers de la Nanyang Brother's Tobacco
C°, mais elle est la conséquence du renvoi des 15 ouvriers
partisans du Directeur Adjoint; ces ouvriers se trouvant
être, en même temps les membres du comité de direction du
bureau des ouvriers de la Nanyang, créé dernièrement au
sein du syndicat.
pages.zh:
机密

对副经理的支持者处以扣薪惩罚。这些操纵手段导致3月20日其中一个车间发生斗殴，随后15名工人被解雇。

为了更顺利地推行其操纵手段，总工程师李辉与其朋友资福生（音译）取得了联系，资福生是大世界游乐场雇员（也是王敬荣的门徒），并竭尽全力提供帮助。

总经理向王敬荣投诉，王敬荣对资福生未事先通知便擅自行动感到非常不满，将其从大世界辞退。同时，王敬荣命令毛玉凤（音译）——另一位门徒，且是报纸分销商工会常设委员会成员——协助总经理与副经理的派系解决3月20日的事件。

冯家洛（音译）正是在“大同”、“东亚”等旅馆进行的或多或少秘密的谈判过程中会见了毛玉凤。

迄今为止，后者的介入似乎并未使事态恶化。南洋兄弟烟草公司的工人中仍持续存在一定程度的骚动，但这是解雇15名副经理派系工人的后果；这些工人同时也是最近在该工会内部成立的南洋工人局指导委员会的成员。

certaine somme en récompense des services qu'il croit avoir
rendus. WANG KING YONG informé de ces démarches, a fait de
vifs reproches à MAO et a même pris une sanction contre lui.

Dear Major Gerrard,

I hand you herewith an English version of the
24 demands delivered to the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Co., Ltd.
by what is called the Branch Office for the said Company's
Factory of the Fourth District Cigarette Labour Union. After
you have read it, I am sure you will agree with me in the view
that the demands are both ridiculous and provocative. It is
said that they have been approved by the Tangpu. I am having
a commentary prepared on some of the demands which are repugnant
to the existing labour law, and it is, therefore, greatly
surprising that the Tangpu should have passed them.

The Tobacco Company is determined to reject the
demands which, if accepted, can only result in its ruination.
As I told you the other day, the trouble has not yet been over
and, in my opinion, will not be over until the ring-leaders have
been brought to justice. In the interests of the public peace
the Police will, no doubt, continue to exercise the utmost

亲爱的Gerrard少校：

现随函附上由所谓第四区卷烟业工会南洋兄弟烟草有限公司工厂办事处递交给该公司的24项要求的英文译本。阅后，我相信您会同意我的看法，即这些要求既荒谬又具有挑衅性。据说这些要求已获党部批准。我正在准备一份评论，指出其中某些要求与现行劳动法相抵触，因此，党部竟然通过这些要求，实在令人惊讶。

烟草公司决心拒绝这些要求，因为一旦接受，只会导致其破产。正如我前几天告诉您的那样，麻烦尚未结束，而且在我看来，除非将首恶分子绳之以法，否则麻烦不会结束。为了公众安宁起见，警方无疑将继续对局势保持最高程度的

vigilance over the situation and accord the Company every

weeks.
After you have gone through the translation, please
pass it on to Major Bourne and Mr.Givens.
I did not know until recently that Mr.Givens 'is
equipped with such a vast knowledge of politics, and for that
reason is really a great asset of the Police Force. I
heartily congratulate you on such a valuable possession!
I am,
Yours sincerely,

AN AGREEMENT made between THE NANYANG TOBACCO FACTORY OFFICE OF
THE FOURTH DISTRICT CIGARETTE LABOUR UNION and THE NANYANG
BROTHERS TOBACCO COMPANY LIMITED:-

(A) ORGANIZATION:

(1) The Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Company of Shanghai (herein-
after called "the Company") recognizes the Fourth District
Cigarette Labour Union as having the authority to represent all
its members in its Nanyang Tobacco Factory Office and further
recognizes the Nanyang Tobacco Factory Office of the Fourth
District Cigarette Labour Union (hereinafter called "the Office")
as having the authority to represent the whole body of workmen.
(2) All the staff members and workmen of the Company and Factory
shall have the right to join the Nanyang Tobacco Factory Office of
the Fourth District Cigarette Labour Union (those representing
the employers to exercise administrative powers excepted).
(3) The Company shall pay to the Office $500.00 every month to
cover its running expenses and shall further pay over to the
Office all the fines inflicted upon the workmen which shall be
used for public benevolence purposes on behalf of the workmen.
(4) The Office is to establish a free school for the sons and
daughters of the workmen of the Nanyang Tobacco Factory and the
Company shall subsidize its establishment expenses and bear its
running expenses.
(5) The Company shall set aside two hong houses for the use of
the Office and its school. If there is no such house available,
the Company shall pay $100.00 to the Office for rent.

receive an increase of $7; those earning $25 to $35 a month an

译文
- - - - - - - - -

第四区卷烟业工会南洋烟草厂办事处与南洋兄弟烟草有限公司之间达成的协议：-

(A) 组织：

(1) 上海南洋兄弟烟草公司（以下简称“公司”）承认第四区卷烟业工会拥有代表其南洋烟草厂办事处所有会员的权力，并进一步承认第四区卷烟业工会南洋烟草厂办事处（以下简称“办事处”）拥有代表全体工人的权力。
(2) 公司及工厂的所有职员和工人均有权加入第四区卷烟业工会南洋烟草厂办事处（代表雇主行使行政权力者除外）。
(3) 公司每月应向办事处支付500.00美元，以涵盖其日常开支，并应将向工人征收的所有罚款移交给办事处，用于代表工人从事公益慈善事业。
(4) 办事处应为南洋烟草厂工人的子女建立一所免费学校，公司应补贴其开办费用并承担其日常开支。
(5) 公司应拨出两栋石库门房屋供办事处及其学校使用。若无此类房屋可用，公司应向办事处支付100.00美元作为租金。

(B) 工资：

(6) 增加工资：月薪12至25美元者，增加7美元；月薪25至35美元者，增加
-1-

pages.en:
increase of $6; those earning $35 to $45 a month an increase of
$5; those earning $45 to $55 a month an increase of $4; those
earning over $55 a month an increase of $3.
(7) For woman workmen in the packing room, an increase of 2d
per 1000 cigarettes packed, whether in soft or hard covers, of
either 10, 20 or 50 cigarettes each. For those engaged in the
pasting room, an increase of 2d per 100 packages pasted. For
those in the tobacco-blending room, an increase of 2d for each
100 lbs. blended.

(C) TREATMENT:
(8) No workmen may be dismissed or fined without proper ground.
In case of any trouble, the Office should be notified and the case
should be dealt with according to the factory regulations but the
fine imposed on each workman shall not exceed $1.00. For serious
offence, the dismissal of any workman can only be effected after
sanction by the government bureau concerned. Special reward
shall be given bythe Company to those workmen who have special
merits.
(Note:- The factory regulations shall be agreed upon by both
parties and approved by the government bureau con-
cerned).
(9) When for business reasons (damp weather as a reason to be
excepted) a reduction of workmen becomes necessary, the Company
shall pay the workmen dismissed six months' extra-wages (calculated
according to the rate of wage earned at the time of dismissal),
but all workmen employed after the signing of this agreement are
not entitled to this privilege only until they have continuously
served the Company for over one year. When the Company again
call for new workmen, those dismissed workmen still residing at
Shanghai shall have the first option of being employed. The
above provision regarding compensation shall apply also when the
Company dismisses any workman at the end of the year. (In the

6美元；月薪35至45美元者，增加5美元；月薪45至55美元者，增加4美元；月薪超过55美元者，增加3美元。
(7) 包装室女工，无论软包或硬包，每包装1000支香烟（每包10支、20支或50支），增加2便士。糊盒间工人，每糊制100包，增加2便士。烟丝拌料间工人，每拌制100磅，增加2便士。

(C) 待遇：
(8) 不得无正当理由解雇或罚款任何工人。如有纠纷，应通知办事处，案件应根据工厂规章处理，但对每名工人的罚款不得超过1.00美元。对于严重违规，解雇任何工人须经有关政府机关批准后方可执行。公司应对有特殊功绩的工人给予特别奖励。
（注：工厂规章应由双方商定，并经有关政府机关批准）。
(9) 当因业务原因（潮湿天气除外）需要裁减工人时，公司应向被解雇的工人支付六个月的额外工资（按解雇时的工资率计算），但在签署本协议后雇佣的所有工人，只有在连续为公司服务超过一年后，才享有此特权。当公司再次招募新工人时，仍居住在上海的被解雇工人拥有优先受雇权。上述关于补偿的规定也适用于公司在年底解雇任何工人的情况。（在
-2-

pages.en:
case of reduction of workmen for business reasons, workmen who
have served the Company for shorter periods shall be first dis-
missed).
(Note:- The above provisions for the payment of compensation
to workmen dismissed shall not be applicable in case
the Company should declare bankruptcy or lose half
of its capital).
(10) Regarding such job-workers employed in the cutting, rolling
and machinery departments such as blacksmiths, plumbers, fitters,
carpenters, electricians, etc. who have worked in the Factory for
over two years and who have proved their abilities each along
their own lines, they shall be promoted to long-term workmen after
passing an appropriate examination. Any new workmen hereafter
employed shall have two years' term of employment.
(11) The Company shall supply the Office with a copy of the Bonus
Account every year before proceeding with its division. After
deducting the Reserved Fund and Depreciation according to the
Regulations of the Company, the profit of the Company shall be
divided into sixteen shares, 10 shares to be paid to its share-
holders and the remaining 6 shares to be set aside for the bonus
of the Directors, Supervisors, Promoters and the whole employees
of the Factory. Out of the said 6 shares of bonus, 17% shall be
paid to the workmen. (For instance, if the net profit of the
Company after deducting the Reserved Fund and Depreciation is
$160,000.00, the bonus of the shareholders shall be $100,000 and
the workmen shall take 17% of the remaining $60,000.00 or
$10,200.00). Only workmen of over one year's service shall be
entitled to the above bonus which shall be distributed propor-
tionate to their wages.
(12) Full wages shall be paid to the workmen, both male and
female, whose sick leave is not over two months upon presentation
of the doctor's certificate, said doctor to be appointed by the
Company. When the sick leave of such workmen is over two months,
-3-
pages.zh:
因业务原因裁减工人的情况下，服务公司期限较短的工人应首先被解雇）。
（注：如果公司宣布破产或损失一半资本，则上述向被解雇工人支付补偿的规定不适用）。
(10) 关于在切割、卷制和机械部门工作的计件工人，如铁匠、水管工、装配工、木匠、电工等，凡在工厂工作超过两年并在各自领域证明其能力者，经适当考试合格后，应晋升为长期工。此后雇佣的任何新工人，雇佣期限为两年。
(11) 公司在分配红利前，每年应向办事处提供一份红利账目副本。根据公司规章扣除公积金和折旧费后，公司利润应分为十六股，其中10股支付给股东，其余6股留作董事、监事、发起人及全厂员工的红利。在上述6股红利中，17%应支付给工人。（例如，如果公司扣除公积金和折旧费后的净利润为160,000.00美元，股东的红利应为100,000美元，工人则获得剩余60,000.00美元的17%，即10,200.00美元）。只有服务超过一年的工人才有资格获得上述红利，红利应按其工资比例分配。
(12) 男女工人病假不超过两个月者，凭医生证明应支付全额工资，该医生由公司指定。当此类工人的病假超过两个月时，
-3-

pages.en:
half wages shall be paid up to one year only. (Only workmen of
over two years' service shall be entitled to this privilege).
(13) Ten days' holiday shall be given to workmen at the end of
every calendar year and one day's holiday on every memorial day
appointed by the National Government. If the Company should
require the services of workmen on such holidays, double wages
shall be paid. The Company shall pay to the workmen $4.00 each
as a festival gratuity at the end of every year.
(14) During the last month of every year, the Company shall, in
addition to ordinary wages, pay to the workmen two months' extra
wages (calculated according to the average amount of the last
three months of the said year). In the case of workmen who
have worked for less than one year, such extra wages shall be
paid proportionate to the number of months of their service.
(Note:- If any workman who is elected to be any officer of
the Office should apply for leave of absence in
connection with his duties as such officer and
produce a letter from the Office certifying to the
same, no deduction shall be made from his wages
for such absence).
(15) Workmen suffering from any kind of illness (venereal disease
excepted) shall be entitled to treatment by the doctors appointed
by the Company and both the doctor's fees and cost of medicine
shall be borne by the Company.
(16) Full wages shall be paid to workmen injured directly in the
course of their duties in the Company, and to those workmen who
are deformed or crippled, thus rendered permanently unable to
work, half wages of an amount not less than $15 shall be paid
till their death. As to workman who died on account of such
injury, the Company shall pay $50 for burial expenses, $300 for
compassionate grant, and a further allowance equal to two years'
average wages, such sums to be paid to the deceased's next of
kin.

pages.zh:
半薪仅支付至一年为止。（仅限服务满两年以上的工人享有此特权）。
(13) 每个公历年度结束时，给予工人十天假期；在国民政府指定的每个纪念日，给予一天假期。若公司在上述假日要求工人提供服务，应支付双倍工资。公司应在每年年底向每位工人支付4.00元作为节日赏金。
(14) 在每年的最后一个月，公司除正常工资外，应向工人支付两个月的额外工资（按该年最后三个月的平均金额计算）。对于工作不满一年的工人，此类额外工资应按其服务月数比例支付。（注：- 若任何被选为工会职员的工人因履行该职员职责而请假，并出具工会证明信证实此事，则其请假期间不得扣除工资）。
(15) 患有任何疾病（性病除外）的工人，有权接受公司指定医生的治疗，诊费及药费均由公司承担。
(16) 在公司任职期间直接受伤的工人，应获得全额工资；对于因伤致残或 crippled，从而永久丧失工作能力的工人，应支付不低于15元的半薪，直至其去世。对于因该类伤害死亡的工人，公司应支付50元丧葬费、300元抚恤金，以及相当于两年平均工资的额外津贴，上述款项应支付给死者的最近亲属。

pages.en:
(17) All female workmen employed both on long and short terms
and job workers are entitled to six weeks' absence both before
and after child-birth without any deduction of wages in the mean-
time. In addition the Company shall pay her $10.00 allowance.
The above shall only apply to workers having more than one year's
service with the Company.
(18) Every working day shall be limited to 10 hours, exceeding
which one hour shall be counted as two hours.
(19) Night work up to 9 p.m. of every department shall be counted
as half-day's work, to 10.30 p.m. as ¾ of a day's work, and to
11-12 p.m. as one day's work. Whole night's work shall be
counted as two days' work.
(20) Workmen are entitled to 20 days' absence for marriage or
funeral without any deduction of wages. With regard to marriage,
the above shall only apply to marriage of the absentee himself,
and with regard to funeral, the above shall only apply to the
funeral of his father, mother, husband or wife.
(21) The Company shall give each job worker 50 cigarettes at the
end of every year.
(22) The Company shall not resort to the unlimited employment of
female job-workers. Whenever the Company desires to increase or
reduce such job-workers, consent of the Office must first be
obtained.
(D) APPENDIX:
(23) This Agreement shall come to force from the day when it is
signed.
(24) This Agreement is subject to amendment at any time by mutual
consent of both parties.

(17) 所有受雇的长期、短期女性工人及计件女工，均有权在产前和产后各休假六周，期间不扣减工资。此外，公司应向其支付10.00元津贴。上述规定仅适用于在公司服务满一年以上的工人。
(18) 每个工作日限定为10小时，超过部分，一小时按两小时计算。
(19) 各部门夜间工作至晚上9点者，按半天工作计算；至晚上10点半者，按四分之三天工作计算；至晚上11点至12点者，按一天工作计算。整夜工作按两天工作计算。
(20) 工人因结婚或丧事有权休假20天，不扣减工资。关于结婚，上述规定仅适用于请假者本人的婚礼；关于丧事，上述规定仅适用于其父亲、母亲、丈夫或妻子的葬礼。
(21) 公司应在每年年底向每位计件工人赠送50支香烟。
(22) 公司不得无限制地雇佣女性计件工人。每当公司希望增加或减少此类计件工人时，必须首先获得工会的同意。
(D) 附录：
(23) 本协议自签署之日起生效。
(24) 经双方同意，本协议可随时修订。

No. D 4611
May 10 Date 1933 5 / 33

Labour

Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory Workers - Union Meeting

Twelve members of the temporary office of the
Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory Workers of the 4th
District Cigarette Workers' Union held a meeting at
106 Chiao Ka Fang Road, city between 2.15 and 3.30 p.m. May 9,
and passed the following resolutions :-

1. That the Bureau of Social Affairs be requested to
convene a meeting of representatives of the Company
and the workers to discuss the conditions for the
agreement which have been approved by the local Kuomintang.

2. That the Chinese Authorities be requested to negotiate
as soon as possible with the management over the
recent dismissal of 15 workers.

3. That another temporary office be established in the
office of the Union at 8 San Loh Li, Baikal Road.

Shin Luen Silk Filature - Transient strike

In consequence of a rumour to the effect that
the management will replace the workers of Kiangpeh nativity
with natives of this city, the 500 workers (natives of
Kiangpeh) of the Shin Luen Silk Filature, 1421 Liu Ying
Road, Chapei, declared a "tai tung" strike in the early
morning of May 9 but resumed at 1 p.m. the same day after
the management assured them that the report was groundless.

Shanghai Municipality Chauffeurs' Union - new body
organized

A new organization entitled the Shanghai Municipality
Chauffeurs' Union has come into existence with a preparatory
office at 2 Yung Ching Li, Min Kuo Road. It is now applying
to the local Kuomintang for registration.

劳工事务

南洋兄弟烟草厂工人 - 工会会议

第四区卷烟业工会南洋兄弟烟草厂工人临时办事处的十二名成员，于5月9日下午2时15分至3时30分，在市内胶州路 (Chiao Ka Fang Road) 106号举行会议，并通过以下决议：-

1. 请社会局召集资方与工人代表开会，讨论已由当地国民党批准的协议条件。

2. 请中国当局尽快就近期解雇15名工人一事与管理层进行交涉。

3. 在贝加尔路 (Baikal Road) 三乐里 (San Loh Li) 8号的工会办事处设立另一个临时办事处。

新伦丝厂 - 短暂罢工

由于有谣言称管理层将用本市籍工人替换江北籍工人，位于闸北柳营路 (Liu Ying Road) 1421号的新伦丝厂 (Shin Luen Silk Filature) 的500名工人（均为江北籍）于5月9日凌晨宣布“怠工” (tai tung) 罢工，但在管理层保证该报道毫无根据后，于当日下午1时复工。

上海市汽车司机工会 - 新组织成立

一个名为“上海市汽车司机工会”的新组织已经成立，筹备处设在民国路 (Min Kuo Road) 永庆里 (Yung Ching Li) 2号。目前正向当地国民党申请注册。

No. D 4611
Date 8, 8 / 5 / 33）

Labour (4)

Yah Zung Sung Kee Printing Works - transient strike

As a protest against the refusal of the employer
to grant them a holiday on May 5 and to reinstate five
of their colleagues, the 130 workers of the Yah Zung Sung
Kee Printing Works, 68 Burkill Road, declared a strike at
9 a.m. May 5. They resumed this morning, May 8 following
the reinstatement of four of the dismissed workers.

National Goods Maintenance Association - Meeting

Some 20 members of the National Goods Maintenance
Association the National Goods Promotion Association
held a meeting in their office, Kwo Tung Road, Kiu Mur
Dee, City, between 3 and 4.30 p.m. May 6, when it was
decided to oppose the inspection of factories by the
Settlement Authorities and to unite various factories
in appealing to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to
allow the task of inspection to be undertaken by a special
committee organized by the national goods factories.

Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory

At 12 noon May 6, eight Chinese claiming to represent
the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory Workers' Union
called on the management of the concern and delivered
a letter containing twenty four demands including the
following :-

1. That the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory Workers'
Union be recognized as the sole representative of
the workers, and that an office of the Union be
established in the factory.

劳工事务 (4)

亚中宋记印刷所 - 短暂罢工

为抗议雇主拒绝给予5月5日假期并拒绝复职五名同事，位于伯基尔路 (Burkill Road) 68号的亚中宋记印刷所 (Yah Zung Sung Kee Printing Works) 的130名工人于5月5日上午9时宣布罢工。随着四名被解雇工人的复职，他们于今晨（5月8日）复工。

国货维持会 - 会议

国货维持会暨国货促进会的约20名成员，于5月6日下午3时至4时30分，在市内九亩地 (Kiu Mur Dee) 郭通路 (Kwo Tung Road) 的办事处举行会议，决定反对租界当局对工厂进行检查，并联合各工厂向大上海市政府呼吁，允许由国货工厂组织的特别委员会承担检查任务。

南洋兄弟烟草厂

5月6日中午12时，八名自称代表南洋兄弟烟草厂工人工会的华人拜访了该公司管理层，并提交了一封包含二十四项要求的信函，其中包括以下内容：-

1. 承认南洋兄弟烟草厂工人工会为工人的唯一代表，并在厂内设立工会办事处。

2. That an increase of wages be granted to all workers,
and that reward be given to those who perform good
services.
3. That a school be established for the children of
workers.
4. That no workers be dismissed without cause.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory, East Broadway.

Made by and Forwarded by Detective Inspector Wardrop

Sir,
Between 3 and 4p.m. 9-5-33, Woo Maung Ling (吳夢麟) and Faung
Phen Zien (方沛泉) representing the 4th District Tobacco Factory
Workers Union together with several representatives of the Nanyang
Brothers Tobacco Factory Workers Union visited the management of
the above Factory for an answer to the twenty four demands sub-
mitted on 6-5-33.
The Manager informed the delegates that their demands had been
sent to Hongkong for consideration by the Directors there, and
that when he received a reply, which he expected in four or five
days time, he would send a letter to the Union giving them the
Directors decision.
The delegates then withdraw peacefully.

I am, Sir,

REPORT

Subject (in full) Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory - dispute among

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

It has been learned from a confidential source
that the majority of information in connection with the
Nanyang Bros. Tobacco Factory submitted to the Police
by Fong Ping Han (馮炳南), 43 Peking Road, and Woo Linquan
(吳麟坤) of the same address has been obtained by them
through Chang Zanghee (張尚義), alias Siao Cheng (小張)
who has been "touting" for Fong for some time past.

It is understood that Chang has for the last
many years been a protege of Fong Ping Han, who it is
believed, was instrumental in introducing him for
employment to the S.M.P.

Very little information has come to hand
during the last few days in connection with the extortion
being practiced by Doo Yueh Sung and Fong Ching Yoong,
nor has anything been learned of the part played by the
various "dudees" of these two men.

One point of interest is that the management
of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory have dismissed
Wong Ih Kung (王延根) ex-detective, S.M.P. who for the
past 4 months has been employed as a confidential agent
among the workers. Wong was known to the Police as
follower of Doo Yueh Sung and is strongly suspected of
being concerned in the present troubles of the Company.

Em Golder
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
5.5.33

档案编号 D 411
日期 1933年5月1日。
日期 1933年5月5日。

报告

主题（全称） 南洋兄弟烟草厂 - 管理层等方面的纠纷。

撰写人：副侦探巡官 Golder 呈报人：督察 Thos Robertson

据机密消息来源获悉，冯炳南 (Fong Ping Han)（北京路43号）及同地址的吴麟坤 (Woo Linquan) 提交给警方的关于南洋兄弟烟草厂的大部分情报，是通过张尚义 (Chang Zanghee)，别名小张 (Siao Cheng) 获得的，此人过去一段时间一直为冯充当线人 (touting)。

据悉，张多年来一直是冯炳南的门徒，据信冯在介绍其进入上海公共租界工部局警务处 (S.M.P.) 任职方面发挥了作用。

在过去几天里，关于杜月笙 (Doo Yueh Sung) 和冯敬庸 (Fong Ching Yoong) 实施的勒索行为，很少有新情报传来，也未了解到这两人的各种“打手” (dudees) 在其中扮演的角色。

值得关注的一点是，南洋兄弟烟草厂管理层已解雇了前警务处侦探王延根 (Wong Ih Kung)，他在过去4个月中被雇佣为混入工人中的密探。警方已知王是杜月笙的追随者，并强烈怀疑他参与了公司目前的麻烦。

Em Golder
副侦探巡官 (D. S. I.)

特别分部主管警官。
1933年5月5日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4611
Date 3 / 5 / 33

May 3, 1933.

Labour

Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory - workers meet

Some 20 Chinese claiming to represent the workers
of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory held a meeting
in the Nanyang Tobacco Office of the 4th District
Cigarette Factory Workers' Union, 105 Jao Ka Pang Road,
City, between 2.30 and 4 p.m. May 1, one Wu Meng Ling
(吴夢麟) presiding. The following resolutions were
discussed and passed:-

1. That representations be made to the local Kuomintang
Headquarters and the Bureau of Social Affairs for
assistance in the demand for the reinstatement of
15 workers who were dismissed on April 17.

2. That the General Labour Union as well as other local
labour unions be requested to render assistance to
the Nanyang Tobacco Factory workers.

3. That the local Kuomintang be requested to investigate
and sanction the draft of the agreement between
labourers and the management of the Nanyang Factory
submitted by the Nanyang Factory Office of the 4th
District Tobacco Factory Workers' Union, and then
pass it to the Bureau of Social Affairs to be dealt
with.

4. That owing to the financial straits of the Union,
each worker of the Nanyang Factory be requested to
contribute $1.00.

1933年5月3日。

劳工事务

南洋兄弟烟草厂 - 工人集会

约20名自称代表南洋兄弟烟草厂工人的华人，于5月1日下午2时30分至4时，在市内胶州路 (Jao Ka Pang Road) 105号的第四区卷烟厂工人工会南洋烟草办事处举行会议，由吴梦麟 (Wu Meng Ling) 主持。讨论并通过了以下决议：-

1. 向当地国民党党部和社会局提出诉求，寻求协助，要求复职4月17日被解雇的15名工人。

2. 请求总工会及其他本地工会向南洋烟草厂工人提供援助。

3. 请求当地国民党调查并批准由第四区烟草厂工人工会南洋厂办事处提交的劳资双方协议草案，然后移交社会局处理。

4. 鉴于工会财政困难，请求南洋厂每位工人捐款1.00元。

May 1st 33

Dear Barton,

I am sending you herewith some copies of
reports regarding a dispute in the Nanyang Bros.
Tobacco Co. which tends to show that the old French
Town opium gang is now supplementing its income
from smuggling activities by promoting racketeering
in Chinese industrial enterprises. There is
reason to believe that the General Labour Union,
a Kuomintang organization for the control of
labour, and the Social Bureau of the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai are under the influence of these
racketeers.

Yours sincerely,

J. Barton, Esq.,
G. V. Kitson, Esq.
British Consulate-General.

亲爱的 Barton，

随函附上几份关于南洋兄弟烟草公司纠纷的报告副本，这些报告显示，旧法租界鸦片帮派正通过在中国工业企业中制造勒索纠纷 (racketeering) 来补充其走私活动的收入。有理由相信，作为国民党控制劳工的组织——总工会，以及大上海市政府的社会局，都受到这些勒索者的影响。

S.l., S.B.
April 27, 1933.

Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory - Details of
existing dispute and alleged extortion as detailed
by Kam Yuh-kah, General Manager.

D.S.I. Golder

To date two versions of the dispute existing between the
management and workers of the above concern have been
prepared, one by D.S. Mac Adie dated March 21 the details of
which were obtained from Kan Ying-poo, Assistant Manager
of the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory and one by the
undersigned also dated March 21, 1933 the data for which
was obtained from Woo Linquan, lawyer of Feng Company,
43 Peking Road, presently the legal representative of the
above Company in Shanghai.

The following account obtained from Kan Yuh-ka during an
interview at his residence No.55 Lane 1400 Avenue Road on
March 26, 1933 besides being a somewhat more detailed
interpretation throws considerable light on the subject
of the extortion practised by Wong Ching-yoong and Doo
Yueh-sung.

Kam Yuh-kah claimed that he left Shanghai during June
of 1932 for Hongkong and Canton and owing to ill health
did not return to the Management of the local factory until
January 1st, 1933.

Upon his arrival at the factory he was given a number
of rather vague items of information regarding money matters
and the non-payment of what is known as the "efficiency
bonus". It was not until January 13, however, that the
matter took definite shape which came in the form of a letter
from the workers of the factory complaining that they had
not been in receipt of their bonus since the manager left
for Hongkong and placed the business in the hands of his
younger brother Kam Ying-poo.

On the day following the receipt of the letter the
pages.zh:
S.l., S.B.
1933年4月27日。

南洋兄弟烟草公司——总经理简玉阶详述现有纠纷及涉嫌勒索之细节。

特别分部督察长 Golder

截至目前，关于上述企业资方与工人之间存在的纠纷，已拟定两份版本：一份由特别分部副督察长 Mac Adie 于3月21日撰写，其细节取自南洋兄弟烟草公司副经理简英普；另一份由本人亦于1933年3月21日撰写，其数据取自北京路43号丰洋行律师、目前为该公司在上海的法定代表吴林泉。

以下记述系于1933年3月26日在爱文义路1400弄55号简玉阶寓所对其进行访谈时所得，除提供更为详尽的解释外，还极大地澄清了黄静庸和杜月笙实施勒索一事。

简玉阶称，他于1932年6月离开上海前往香港和广州，因健康欠佳，直至1933年1月1日才返回本地工厂的管理岗位。

抵达工厂后，他获悉了一些关于财务事宜以及未支付所谓“效率奖金”的相当模糊的信息。然而，直到1月13日，此事才具体化，形式为工厂工人发来的一封信，抱怨自经理前往香港并将业务交予其弟简英普掌管以来，他们一直未收到奖金。

在收到该信的次日，

pages.en:
- 2 -

brothers conferred on the matter and, it is alleged, Kam
Ying-poo told his brother, the manager, that the matter of
the bonus was entirely the business of one Li Hwei, Factory
Superintendent, who was entrusted with the distribution of
the money under regulations laid down by the management.
Kam uh-ka refused to accept this view of the matter and
for the time being insisted that disciplinary and if
necessary legal action be taken against Li Hwei for "mis-
appropriation". Immediately following the conversation
between the brothers, Kan Yuh-ka called a meeting of charge-
hands and foremen questioning them regarding their knowledge
of the non-payment of the "Bonus". All claimed that they
had heard rumours but were unable to offer any definite
information. On Saturday January 14, 1933 observing
that the matter was assuming proportions likely to be beyond
his power of management Kam Yuh-kah obtained the account
books referring to the "Bonus" and called on a firm of
Chartered Accountants namely Zee Yoong-tso (徐永祚) of 38
Avenue Edward VII who removed the records to their
offices.

During the ensuing weekend Kam Ying-poo exerted every
effort to persuade his brother to drop the case and in so
doing revealed that he was hand in glove with "Li Hwei's
scheme".

On Monday, January 16 Kam Yuh-ka fearing that his
opponent intended doing him injury ordered the return of the
account books to his office. Although he intended to hand them
over to the workmen as suggested by Kam Ying-poo, Kam
Yuh-ka obtained the services of a photographer and was
pages.zh:
- 2 -

兄弟二人就此事项进行了商议，据称，简英普告诉其兄（经理），奖金事宜完全属于工厂监工李辉的业务范围，李辉受命按照管理层制定的规定分发款项。简玉阶拒绝接受这一观点，并暂时坚持对李辉的“挪用公款”行为采取纪律处分，必要时采取法律行动。兄弟谈话结束后，简玉阶立即召集领班和工头开会，询问他们是否知晓未发放“奖金”的情况。所有人都声称听说过谣言，但无法提供任何确切信息。1933年1月14日星期六，简玉阶观察到事态发展可能超出其管理能力，于是调取了有关“奖金”的账簿，并聘请了一家特许会计师事务所，即爱文义路38号的徐永祚（Zee Yoong-tso），将记录移至其事务所。

在接下来的周末期间，简英普竭尽全力劝说其兄放弃此案，在此过程中暴露出他与“李辉的阴谋”狼狈为奸。

1月16日星期一，简玉阶担心对手意图伤害他，命令将账簿归还其办公室。虽然他打算按照简英普的建议将账簿移交给工人，但简玉阶聘请了一位摄影师，并正

pages.en:
- 3 -

proceeding with the photographing of the books in his
office when about 20 of the workmen presented themselves
at the door demanding that the books be handed over to
them. Owing to the flimsy construction of the door
those outside the office were able to see the photographer
at work and with a view to putting a stop to what they
loudly protested was an interference with their business,
cut the electric cable leaving t e room with insufficient
light.

At this junction the pictures already taken were
found to be sufficient to prove the guilt of Li Hwei
and Kam Ying-poo. Kam Yuh-kah therefore made no further
protest but handed over the books to a select delegation
of employees namely :
Pan Yuen-tsung (潘雨村)
Lau King-seu (勞敬修)
Liang Siang-tsz (梁相滋)

Before leaving the office the three men were informed that
irrespective of what action they intended to take against
Li Hwei the management intended to dismiss him.

The intention of the management eventually came to
the knowledge of Li Hwei who collected a group of his
followers and proceeded to the Manager's Office where a
somewhat heated altercation took place. They subsequently
left and returned to their work with the exception of Li
Hwei who, it is alleged, upon the suggestion of Kam Ying-poo
proceeded to the residence of Doo Yueh-sung.

Exactly what took place at Doo's house is not
known, it is suspected, however, that he suggested
pages.zh:
- 3 -

在其办公室对账簿进行拍摄时，约20名工人出现在门口，要求将账簿交给他们。由于办公室门结构单薄，门外的人能够看到摄影师在工作，为了制止他们大声抗议的所谓干涉其事务的行为，他们切断了电缆，导致房间内光线不足。

在此关头，已拍摄的照片被认为足以证明李辉和简英普有罪。因此，简玉阶未再提出进一步抗议，而是将账簿移交给选定的员工代表，即：
潘雨村 (Pan Yuen-tsung)
勞敬修 (Lau King-seu)
梁相滋 (Liang Siang-tsz)

在离开办公室前，这三人被告知，无论他们打算对李辉采取何种行动，管理层均打算将其解雇。

管理层的意图最终被李辉知晓，他召集了一群追随者前往经理办公室，双方发生了相当激烈的争吵。随后，除李辉外，其他人离开并回去工作。据称，李辉在简英普的建议下，前往杜月笙的住所。

确切地说，在杜家发生了什么并不为人所知，但有人怀疑，杜建议

pages.en:
- 4 -

that the Manager should be threatened with bodily injury
should he attempt to enter the factory. The threat in a
veiled form was conveyed to Kam Yuh-ka by his brother
Kam Ying-poo who visited his residence at 55 Lane 1400
Avenue Road.

As the result of the information carried by Kan Ying-poo
Kam senior did not attend the factory during the ensuing three
days but made repeated attempts to find out how matters
were proceeding.

Being unaware of the nature of the negotiations being
carried on by "Doo" Kam Yuh-ka rang up the daughter of Ching
Bing-hym, one Zung Kwei-kyi and Wong Tuh-ying, concubine of
his brother Kam Tsau-nan (both women being big shareholders
in the company) and asked their advice. Zung Kwei-kyi on
hearing of the impasse suggested that the matter be referred to
Chung Koo-zung (鐘万成 ), comprador of the China Realty
Company, an erstwhile sweetheart.

The result of this move lead to Kan Yuh-ka visiting
Doo Yueh-sung and eventually comin to terms, foremost of
which were that Li Hwei, who "Doo" had previously promised
to assist, should be dismissed as from January 31 and that
"Doo" should be presented with 9,000 shares, the requisite
holding to make him a director of the company. In return
for this he promised to settle the affair and appoint the
following persons to safeguard the interests of the company:

1. Zee Tuh-sung (徐德生), Dudee of Doo Yueh-sung
2. Yoong Ping-kung (余炳根) } No information at hand, enquiries
3. Ma Tsung-sung (馬祥生) } proceeding.
4. Tsai Foh-dong (蔡福棠), comprador of Essenden &
pages.zh:
- 4 -

如果经理试图进入工厂，应对其施加人身伤害威胁。这一威胁以含蓄的方式由简英普传达给简玉阶，当时简英普拜访了简玉阶位于爱文义路1400弄55号的寓所。

由于简英普带来的消息，简玉阶在随后的三天内未去工厂，但多次尝试了解事态进展。

由于不了解“杜”正在进行的谈判性质，简玉阶打电话给郑秉贤的女儿宗桂姬，以及其兄简照南的妾室王图英（两位女性均为公司大股东），征求她们的意见。宗桂姬听闻僵局后，建议将此事项提交给中国置业公司买办、她以前的恋人钟万成（Chung Koo-zung）。

此举的结果是，简玉阶拜访了杜月笙并最终达成妥协，首要条件是此前杜承诺协助的李辉应于1月31日起被解雇，并且应向“杜”赠送9,000股股票，这是使其成为公司董事所需的持股量。作为回报，他承诺解决此事，并任命以下人员以保护公司利益：

1. 徐德生 (Zee Tuh-sung)，杜月笙的门徒
2. 余炳根 (Yoong Ping-kung) } 手头无资料，正在
3. 馬祥生 (Ma Tsung-sung) } 查询中。
4. 蔡福棠 (Tsai Foh-dong)，九江路11号 Essenden &

pages.en:
- 5 -

Holcomb, 11 Kiukiang Road and operator
of the Zang Foong Estate Company at the
same address which is allegedly financed
by Doo Yueh-sung.

In addition he placed two followers namely Yau and
Wong Ih-kung (王逸公), an ex-S.M.P. detective in the factory
to obtain information regarding any agitation likely to upset
the arrangements for the settlement.

The arrangements made by Kam Yuh-ka were conveyed to
the Board of Directors in Hongkong who instructed that the
whole matter should be dropped and allowed to go to law.
This led to a breakdown of negotiations with Doo and as
the dispute had taken on major proportions resort was
again made to the /assistance of Chung Koo Zung. He
conferred with Wong Ching-yoong who promised to have the
dispute settled. Kam Yuh-ka obtained a native bank order
for $15,000 and paid it to Chung who in turn is alleged
to have paid it to Wong.

The initial sum apparently whetted the appetite of
"Wong" who demanded a further sum of $45,000. This amount
was raised among the Kam family excluding Kam Ying-poo
and was paid to one Liu Ting who handed " to Doong Ka-bang.

Negotiations broke down again owing to the inter-
ference of "Doo" and resulted in the refunding of $30,000
in 毛雨峯 唐家 native bank orders.

At the present time Mau Yui-foong and Dong Kah-bang
are working to obtain contact with Kam Yuh-ka through
馮家駿
an employee named Vong Char-loh who has already attended
two meetings held in the Sing Lai Hwo Yuen, a brothel on
pages.zh:
- 5 -

Holcomb 公司的买办，并在同一地址经营 allegedly 由杜月笙资助的臧丰地产公司。

此外，他还安排了两名追随者，即姚某和王逸公（Wong Ih-kung，一名前公共租界警务处侦探）进入工厂，以获取有关任何可能破坏和解安排的煽动活动的信息。

简玉阶达成的安排被转达给香港的董事会，董事会指示应放弃整个事项，让其诉诸法律。这导致与杜的谈判破裂，由于纠纷已演变为重大事态，再次寻求钟万成的协助。他与黄静庸进行了会谈，黄承诺解决纠纷。简玉阶开具了一张15,000元的庄票支付给钟，据称钟又将其支付给了黄。

这笔初始款项显然吊起了“黄”的胃口，他要求再支付45,000元。这笔款项由简氏家族筹集（不包括简英普），并支付给刘某，刘又将其转交给唐家邦。

由于“杜”的干涉，谈判再次破裂，导致退还了30,000元，形式为毛雨峯、唐家的庄票。

目前，毛雨峯和唐家邦正通过一名名为冯家骏的员工 Vong Char-loh 试图与简玉阶建立联系，此人已参加了两次在爱文义路法租界一侧的新丽花苑（妓院）举行的会议。在这些会议上，提到了张尚义（Chang Zang-nee，小张）的名字，称其为“师父”，并提及通过此人最终解决纠纷。关于解决方法的另一次会议于晚上9点在爱文义路法租界一侧的赛丰苑（妓院）举行。Vong Char-loh 出席了会议，并与杜的一位此前未提及的门徒周阿天（Chow Ah-tien，原文不清）进行了交谈，周告知 Vong，“师父”不认可他作为负责谈判如此重要事务的人选，如果公司希望解决此事，必须任命一位更有影响力的人与唐家邦做出最终安排。

D. S. I.

特别分部主管警官，

pages.en:
- 6 -

the French side of Avenue Edward VII. At these meetings
the name of Chang Zang-nee (張尚義), Siau Chang, has been
mentioned as "Master" and reference has been made to the
ultimate settlement of the dispute through this individual.
A further meeting regarding the method of settlement
was held at 9 p.m. in the Saiy Foong Yuen (Brothel), French
Side, Avenue Edward VII. Vong Char-loh attended and had
conversation with one Chow Ah-tien (    ), a Dudee of
"Doo's" but hitherto not mentioned, who informed Vong
that the master did not approve of him as a person responsible
to negotiate such an important affair and that if the
Company desired to settle the matter they would have to appoint
a more influential person to make the final arrangements
with Tang Ka-bang.

D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch,
pages.zh:
- 6 -

爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）法租界一侧。在这些会议上，张尚义（Chang Zang-nee），即小章（Siau Chang），的名字被提及为“师父”，并提到将通过此人最终解决纠纷。

关于解决方法的一次进一步会议于晚上9点在爱多亚路法租界一侧的赛丰园（Saiy Foong Yuen，妓院）举行。王查理（Vong Char-loh）出席，并与周阿天（Chow Ah-tien，原文不清）进行了交谈，周是“杜氏”（Doo's）的一名杜伊（Dudee，音译），但此前未曾提及。周告知王，师父不认可他作为负责谈判如此重要事务的人选，如果公司希望解决此事，就必须任命一位更有影响力的人士与唐嘉邦（Tang Ka-bang）做出最终安排。

April 28, 1933.

Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory - dispute among
Managers and employees - Information re loafers
- interview with Mr. Chun Ping-him

D.S.I. Golder

With reference to my report on the subject of the
dispute existing in the above Company dated April 27, 1933
page 4 paragraph 3.

Yoong Ping-kung (榮柄根), is known to be a loafer of
the more pronounced type and is a follower of Doo Yueh-sung,
locally he is known as Lai Kyah (sore foot) Ping Kung.

Ma Tsung-sung (馬祥生), another loafer and a known
associate of opium smugglers and gamblers in known
locally as "Mafoo" Tsung-sung, is a close associate of
Chang Zang-nee (Siao Chang) (張南義)

In continuance of the enquiry into the failing, etc.
of the Management of the Nanyang Factory and the activities
of Doo Yueh Sung, a visit was paid to the office of Chun
Ping-him, Compradore for A.W. Burkill & Co., No.2 Canton Rd.

Mr. Chun stated that he had observed the direction in
which the Nanyang Business was proceeding, as far back as
1929 and decided to liquidate his shares and quit the
concern. Since 1929 he has not taken any active part
in the management and does not know the reason for the
present intrigue. Questioned as to the characters of the
Brothers, Kam Yuh-ka and Kam Ying-poo, he stated, that
Kam Yuh-kah was honest but very easily influenced, whilst
in dealings with Kam Ying-poo, he had discovered him to be
a most unscrupulous individual.

The Company, he stated, could not hope to make a
profit under the present system of management nor whilst the
present departmental managers are in power. In Mr. Chun's
opinion most of them are nothing more than "labour bosses"
who operate hand in glove with the French Concession clique.

南洋兄弟烟草公司——管理层与员工之间的纠纷——关于游手好闲者的信息——与秦平咸先生的访谈

特别分部督察长 Golder

参照本人于1933年4月27日提交的关于上述公司存在纠纷的报告，第4页第3段。

余炳根（Yoong Ping-kung，荣柄根）被认为是那种较为典型的游手好闲者，是杜月笙的追随者， locally 被称为“癞脚”炳坤（Lai Kyah Ping Kung）。

马祥生（Ma Tsung-sung），另一名游手好闲者，也是众所周知的鸦片走私者和赌徒的同伙， locally 被称为“马夫”祥生，是张南义（Chang Zang-nee，小张）的密切同伙。

为了继续调查南洋工厂管理层的过失等以及杜月笙的活动，本人走访了广东路2号 A.W. Burkill & Co. 公司买办秦平咸先生的办公室。

秦先生表示，他早在1929年就观察到了南洋业务的走向，并决定清算其股份并退出该企业。自1929年以来，他未积极参与管理，也不了解当前阴谋的原因。当被问及简玉阶和简英普兄弟二人的品行时，他表示，简玉阶诚实但极易受影响，而在与简英普打交道时，他发现他是一个最肆无忌惮的人。

他表示，在目前的管理体制下，以及在现任部门经理掌权期间，公司无望盈利。在秦先生看来，他们大多数人不过是与法租界帮派狼狈为奸的“包工头”。

The following account obtained from 簡 玉 階 Kam Yuh-ka during an
interview at his residence No.55 Lane 1400 Avenue Road on
March 26, 1933 besides being a somewhat more detailed
interpretation throws considerable light on the subject
of the extortion practised by 黃 全 榮 Wong Ching-yoon; and 杜 月 笙 Doo
Yuen-sung.

簡 玉 階
Kam Yuh-kah claimed that he left Shanghai during June
of 1932 for Hongkong and Canton and owing to ill health
did not return to the management of the local factory until
January 1st, 1933.

Upon his arrival at the factory he was given a number
of rather vague items of information regarding money matters
and the non-payment of what is known as the "efficiency
bonus". It was not until January 15 however that the
matter took definite shape which came in the form of a letter
from the workers of the factory complaining that they had
not been in receipt of their bonus since the manager left
for Hongkong and placed the business in the hands of his
younger brother 簡 英 甫 Kam Ying-poo.

Factory who visited Tu Yueh-sung on February 1, 1933

以下是附呈备忘录中提及的鲜为人知的人物：-

1. 唐家鵬（Dong Ka Bang），又名唐阿裕（Daung Ah Yeu），法租界著名的游手好闲之徒，现为“大世界”经理，曾被指控“绑架”但获释。是黃金榮（Wong Ching-yoong (黃金榮)）的门徒，涉嫌是多起勒索案背后的主谋。曾因干扰南市电车公司（Nantao Tramway Co.）的运营而被中国当局通缉。

MEMORANDUM
----------

At about 9 p.m. yesterday, the 24th April, 1933, a meeting was
held in room No.10, Ningpo Hotel (甯波飯店), the object of which
was that one Mou Yue Foong (毛雨峯) one of the disciples (known in
Chinese as "Doo Di") of Dong Kar Bang (唐家鵬), the latter is the
agent of Wong King Yoong and Tu Yush Sung, as representative of Dong
Kar Bang, was to discuss with Vong Char Loh (馮家樂) with the object
of extorting a lump sum from the Nanyang Brothers. What exactly
took place at the meeting in question was to the following effect:-
Vong Char Loh was approached by two of the fifteen dismissed workers,
namely Chu Ah Lien and Zee Tsu Pao, who are two of the disciples of
Dong Kar Bang with a view to have a friendly talk.
When Vong Char Loh arrived at room No.10 above referred to, there
were already present Mou Yue Foong, 周阿連 Chu Ah Lien and 徐珠寶 Zee Tsu Pao, and
some others whose names are unknown.
Mou Yue Foong at first suggested that the friendly talk should take
place somewhere else.
He then brought the parties to a brothel house known as Zai Fong Yuen
(嘉芳院), in the French Concession.
When they arrived there Mou Yue Foong started the conversation.
He suggested that he has been sent by Dong Kar Bang, representative of
Wong King Yoong and Tu Yush Sung, to find out if there was any way
to compromise the case.
He alleged that as/Vong Char Loh was in confidential relation with the
General Manager, Mr.Kam Yoh Ka, of the Nanyang Brothers, therefore
he, Vong, should bring words to the General Manager and ask him to
give a satisfactory answer.
He further suggested that both Wong King Yoong and Tu Yush Sung have
lost great face in connection with the Nanyang Brothers' case and
said that unless some offer is made to satisfy them the present trouble
would never end and several lives might be lost if their scheme totally
failed. Amongst them the names of Kan Yoh Ka, Feng Ping Nan and Woo
Ling Quan were mentioned.
-1-
pages.zh:
备忘录
----------

昨晚，即1933年4月24日晚上9点左右，在宁波饭店（甯波飯店）10号房间举行了一次会议，目的是由唐家鵬（Dong Kar Bang）的门徒之一（中文称为“徒弟”）毛雨峯（Mou Yue Foong），作为黃金榮（Wong King Yoong）和杜月笙（Tu Yush Sung）的代理人唐家鵬的代表，与馮家樂（Vong Char Loh）进行讨论，旨在向南洋兄弟烟草公司敲诈一笔整款。在该次会议上发生的具体情况如下：-
馮家樂被两名被解雇的工人中的两人，即朱阿连（Chu Ah Lien）和徐珠宝（Zee Tsu Pao）接近，此二人均为唐家鵬的门徒，目的是进行友好谈话。
当馮家樂到达上述10号房间时，毛雨峯、周阿連（Chu Ah Lien）和徐珠寶（Zee Tsu Pao）以及其他几名姓名不详的人已经在那里。
毛雨峯起初建议友好谈话应在别处进行。
随后他将各方带到法租界一家名为嘉芳院（Zai Fong Yuen）的妓院。
到达那里后，毛雨峯开始谈话。
他表示自己是受黃金榮和杜月笙的代理人唐家鵬派遣，来探询是否有妥协此案的方法。
他声称，由于馮家樂与南洋兄弟烟草公司总经理金裕嘉（Mr.Kam Yoh Ka）关系密切，因此馮应向总经理传话，并要求其给出令人满意的答复。
他进一步表示，黃金榮和杜月笙在南洋兄弟烟草公司一案中丢了很大的面子，并称除非提出某种条件使他们满意，否则目前的麻烦永远不会结束，如果他们的计划彻底失败，可能会丧命数人。其中提到了金裕嘉（Kan Yoh Ka）、冯平南（Feng Ping Nan）和吴麟全（Woo Ling Quan，即吴麟坤）的名字。
-1-

pages.en:
Lou further stated that in fact Kam Yoh Ka himself is a man of no use
and is weak as a lamb and both Woo Ling Quan and Feng Ping Nan are
working to assist him at his back.
He also suggested that the possible compromise would be that the two
dismissed workers (Chu and Zee) be reinstated and a lump sum be paid.
On Vong Cher Loh's reply that he has been unable to compromise a matter
of this nature, Lou suggested that he, Vong, should bring this news to
the notice of the General Manager, who should, in turn, approach Chang
Zang Noo, otherwise known as Siao Chang, to carry on further discussion
because they, Lou's parties, have confidence in him.
The meeting was concluded that Vong Kar Loh should give a definite
answer to Lou some time tonight in the Ningpo Hotel as to the attitude
of the General Manager, Kan Yoh Ka, on the matter.

-2-
pages.zh:
娄（Lou，即毛）还声称，事实上金裕嘉本人是个无用之人，软弱如羔羊，而吴麟全和冯平南都在背后协助他。
他还建议，可能的妥协方案是复职两名被解雇的工人（朱和徐）并支付一笔整款。
针对馮家樂（Vong Cher Loh）回复称他无法调和此类事务，娄建议馮应将此消息告知总经理，总经理应转而接触张丙森（Chang Zang Noo，又名小长 Siao Chang）以继续进行讨论，因为娄的一方对他有信心。
会议结束时决定，馮家樂（Vong Kar Loh）应于今晚某个时间在宁波饭店就总经理金裕嘉（Kan Yoh Ka）对此事的态度向娄给出明确答复。

REPORT
Date April 28, 1933

Subject (in full) Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory - dispute
among Managers and employees - Information re
loafers - interview with Mr. Chun Bing-him.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

With reference to my report on the subject of the
dispute existing in the above Company dated April 27, 1933
page 4, paragraph 3.

Yoong Ping-kung (榮炳根) is known to be a loafer of
the more pronounced type and is a follower of Doo Yueh-sung,
locally he is known as Lai Kyah (sore foot) Ping Kung.

Ma Tsung-sung (馬祥生) another loafer and a known
associate of opium smugglers and gamblers is known
locally as "Mafoo" Tsung-sung, is a close associate of
Chang Zang-nee (Siao Chang). (張尚義)

In continuance of the enquiry into the failing, etc.
of the Management of the Nanyang Factory and the activities
of Doo Yueh Sung, a visit was paid to the office of Chun
Bing-him, Compradore for A.W. Burkill & Co., No.2 Canton Rd.

Mr. Chun stated that he had observed the direction in
which the Nanyang business was proceeding, as far back as
1929 and decided to liquidate his shares and quit the
concern. Since 1929 he has not taken any active part
in the management and does not know the reason for the
present intrigue. Questioned as to the characters of the
Brothers, Kam Yuh-ka and Kam Ying-poo, he stated, that
Kam Yuh-kah was honest but very easily influenced, whilst
in dealings with Kam Ying-poo, he had discovered him to be
a most unscrupulous individual.

The Company, he stated, could not hope to make a
profit under the present system of management nor whilst the
present departmental managers are in power. In Mr. Chun's
opinion most of them are nothing more than "labour bosses"
who operate hand in glove with the French Concession clique.

制作人 副督察 Golder 转呈人 Superintendent Thos Robertson.

关于我于1933年4月27日提交的关于上述公司存在争端的报告第4页第3段。

荣炳根（Yoong Ping-kung）被认为是那种更为典型的游手好闲之徒，是杜月笙的追随者， locally 被称为“癞脚”炳根（Lai Kyah (sore foot) Ping Kung）。

马祥生（Ma Tsung-sung），另一名游手好闲者，众所周知的鸦片走私者和赌徒的同伙， locally 被称为“马夫”祥生（"Mafoo" Tsung-sung），是张尚义（Chang Zang-nee (Siao Chang). (張尚義)）的亲密伙伴。

为了继续调查南洋工厂管理层的失败等情况以及杜月笙的活动，走访了广东路2号 A.W. Burkill & Co. 公司的买办秦炳钦（Chun Bing-him）的办公室。

秦先生表示，早在1929年他就观察到了南洋业务的走向，并决定清算股份退出该公司。自1929年以来，他未积极参与管理，也不了解当前阴谋的原因。当被问及金氏兄弟，即金裕嘉和金英普的性格时，他表示，金裕嘉诚实但极易受人影响，而在与金英普打交道时，他发现他是一个最肆无忌惮的人。

他表示，在当前的管理体系下，以及在现任部门经理掌权期间，公司无望盈利。在秦先生看来，他们中的大多数人不过是与法租界帮派勾结的“包工头”。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / P/B 登记处）

Subject (in full) Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory - Social Bureau conducts mediation.
Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Ths Robertson Supt.

Between 1 and 3.30 p.m. April 24, representatives of the management of the above concern and delegates from the workers' union met in the Bureau of Social Affairs at the request of the Bureau officials to discuss the present dispute.

The Union delegates demanded that the 15 workers dismissed on April 17 for alleged anti-management activities be reinstated. In replying to this demand the management representative stated that the company had carefully considered the dismissal of the 15 men in question and were fully satisfied that their action was justified and that they did not intend to allow them to return to work. The matter was then allowed to remain unsettled.

In connection with the existing dispute Woo Lin-yun of Feng Ping Nan & Company, 43 Peking Road, local representatives of the company, stated that Wong Ping, an official of the Social Bureau and Sang Sun; of the local Tangpu headquarters, both of whom have been detailed by their respective departments to settle the affairs of the Nanyang workers, had been guilty of irregular conduct. This matter has already been brought to the notice of the Mayor of Greater Shanghai but so far no action has been taken. A further petition will be forwarded in due course demanding an immediate investigation, failing which the Company intend to take the matter up with the Nanking Government.

With reference to the demands submitted by the seven Cantonese union delegates (Vide my reports dated April 11 and 12), these men have since expressed their willingness

April 25, 1933. Morning Translation.

LABOUR.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE NANYANG BROTHERS TOBACCO FACTORY.

On April 17, the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory put up a poster announcing the dismissal of 15 workers. This gave rise to dissatisfaction among the entire body of workers who requested the local Tangpu and other political organs to mediate.
At 2 p.m. yesterday, the Social Bureau held an informal meeting at which representatives of the local Tangpu, the Nanyang Brothers Tobacco Factory and the workers were present.
The workers' representatives stated that the 15 workers were dismissed without any just cause and therefore, they should be reinstated.
When requested by the Bureau to reinstate the 15 dismissed men, the representatives of the Factory promised to refer the matter to the Manager for consideration.
A formal mediation meeting will be held by the local Tangpu and other political organs.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

THE WORKERS OF THE TIEN E. SILK FILATURE.

On April 4, the Tien E. Silk Filature at No. 258 Tseng Sun Road posted a notice that the wages of permanent workers will be reduced by 20% and the wages of the reserved hands by 10%; that daily bonus(?) of 50 cents to each worker, the reward for good work, and the special monthly grant of $1 to each worker will be abolished.
The Filature began to enforce these changes from April 6 and its action was opposed by the entire body of workers numbering about 260 hands.
At 3.20 p.m. yesterday, 4 representatives of the workers submitted an appeal to the Social Bureau. They were informed that mediation will be undertaken after an investigation has been made.

"GO-slow" Strike in the Kuo Hwa Silk Filature.

Recently, the Kuo Hwa Silk Filature at Pah Sz Jao, Chapel, ordered the workers to contribute a sum of $100 towards the aviation funds.
About 180 workers objected and at 1 p.m. yesterday they went on a "go-slow" strike. At 3 p.m. 7 representatives were detailed to submit an appeal to the Social Bureau to mediate.
The Bureau instructed the strikers to resume work and to await a settlement

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

南洋兄弟烟草厂工人。

4月17日，南洋兄弟烟草厂张贴告示，宣布解雇15名工人。此举引起全体工人的不满，他们请求本地汤浦（Tangpu，音译）及其他政治机构进行调解。
昨日下午2时，社会局举行了一次非正式会议，本地汤浦、南洋兄弟烟草厂及工人的代表均出席。
工人代表表示，这15名工人被无故解雇，因此应当复职。
当社会局要求工厂复职这15名被解雇人员时，工厂代表承诺将此事项提交经理考虑。
本地汤浦及其他政治机构将举行正式调解会议。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

天乙丝厂工人。

4月4日，曾孙路（Tseng Sun Road，音译）258号的天乙丝厂（Tien E. Silk Filature，音译）张贴通知，称固定工人的工资将减少20%，留用工人的工资减少10%；取消每位工人每日50美分的奖金（原文存疑）、优秀工作奖励以及每月每位工人1美元的特别津贴。
该丝厂从4月6日开始执行这些变更，其行动遭到约260名全体工人的反对。
昨日下午3时20分，4名工人代表向社会局提交申诉。他们被告知，将在调查后进行调解。

国华丝厂的“怠工”罢工。

最近，位于帕斯乔（Pah Sz Jao，音译）教堂附近的国华丝厂（Kuo Hwa Silk Filature，音译）命令工人捐款100美元作为航空基金。
约180名工人表示反对，并于昨日下午1时进行“怠工”罢工。下午3时，派出7名代表向社会局提交申诉，请求调解。
社会局指示罢工者恢复工作，等待解决方案

Cigarette Factory Workers' Union held a meeting in their

LABOUR.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:

GENERAL LABOUR UNION AND THE REDUCTION OF WORK IN
COTTON MILLS.

The General Labour Union yesterday sent the
following telegram to the Ministry of Industry of the National
Government:-
"Silk and tea are the two principal industries
of China. Owing to mismanagement these industries have
become bankrupt. At present the only large industry is
cotton.
"In order to save themselves from suffering the
same fate as the tea and silk industries, Chinese cotton
merchants should devise means to improve and develop this
industry. According to newspaper reports the Chinese Cotton
Mills Federation has decided to stop work for one day each week
as from April 22, and to impose fines for violation of this
resolution.
"If this decision be carried out, the product of
Chinese cotton goods will be reduced and foreign merchants
will take advantage of the opportunity to increase their
products which will gradually take the place of Chinese goods.
This negative measure of reducing work will not only affect
the livelihood of the hundreds of thousands of workers, but
will endanger the cotton industry of China. The decision
to reduce work is unlawful. Furthermore, the Federation
is compelling cotton mills throughout the country to observe
this decision without the approval of the Government.
"Our Union will oppose this reduction of labour
and we hereby request you to issue an order to prevent the
reduction being carried out."

to dismiss our members with the object of destroying the

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

总工会与棉纺厂减产。

总工会昨日向国民政府实业部发出如下电报：
“丝绸和茶叶是中国的两大主要产业。由于经营不善，这些产业已破产。目前唯一的大型产业是棉花。
“为了使自身免受与茶丝产业相同的命运，中国棉商应设法改善和发展这一产业。据报纸报道，华商纱厂联合会决定自4月22日起每周停工一天，并对违反此决议者处以罚款。
“如果执行此决定，中国棉制品的产量将减少，外国商人将利用这个机会增加其产品，从而逐渐取代中国商品。这种消极的减产措施不仅会影响数十万工人的生计，还将危及中国的棉花产业。减产决定是违法的。此外，联合会在未经政府批准的情况下，强迫全国各地的棉纺厂遵守此决定。
“本会将反对此次减工，特此请求贵部发布命令，阻止减产实施。”
